RC-01.name: Administratively Down Interface
RC-01.description: Detects when a network interface has been manually disabled with a shutdown directive.

RC-02.name: Physical Line Protocol Check
RC-02.description: Checks if physical carrier signal or line protocol is down.

RC-03.name: Subnet Mask Mismatch Check
RC-03.description: Detects subnet mask discrepancies on point-to-point links or interface segments.

RC-04.name: Default Gateway Validation
RC-04.description: Ensures default gateway assignments point to reachable and correctly matched interfaces.

RC-05.name: Duplicate IP Address Conflict
RC-05.description: Detects duplicate IP addresses on a segment via ARP conflicts or syslog DUPADDR alerts.

RC-06.name: Local VLAN Database Integrity
RC-06.description: Verifies if the VLAN database contains the required VLAN records for assigned switchports.

RC-07.name: Native VLAN Trunk Sync
RC-07.description: Detects native VLAN mismatches across connected trunk ports.

RC-08.name: Subnet Routing Integrity
RC-08.description: Validates routing tables for complete subnet reachability, static default routes, or OSPF route advertisements.

RC-09.name: Access Control List Audit
RC-09.description: Inspects access lists for implicit or explicit deny blocks on standard application ports.

RC-10.name: DHCP Lease Pool Capacity
RC-10.description: Evaluates DHCP binding statistics and alerts when pools reach 100% exhaustion or Option 43 is missing.

RC-11.name: DHCP Helper Address Validation
RC-11.description: Ensures routing interfaces forwarding broadcast requests have ip helper-address configured.

RC-12.name: NAT Pool Capacity Verification
RC-12.description: Checks dynamic NAT pool translation capacity and flags translation creation failures.

RC-13.name: Port Security Violation Check
RC-13.description: Detects interfaces in err-disabled state due to port-security MAC violations.

RC-14.name: NAT Configuration Check (Inside/Outside)
RC-14.description: Checks for missing ip nat inside or ip nat outside declarations on routing interfaces.

RC-15.name: 802.1Q Encapsulation Verification
RC-15.description: Validates subinterface dot1Q encapsulation tags against target VLAN assignments.
